title: Realistic Continual Learning Approach using Pre-trained Models
abstract: arXiv:2404.07729v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Continual learning (CL) evaluates adaptability in learning solutions to retain knowledge. Our research addresses the challenge of catastrophic forgetting, where models lose proficiency in previously learned tasks as they acquire new ones. While numerous solutions have been proposed, existing experimental setups often rely on idealized class-incremental learning scenarios. We introduce Realistic Continual Learning (RealCL), a novel CL paradigm where class distributions across tasks are random. We also present CLARE (Continual Learning Approach with pRE-trained models for RealCL scenarios), a pre-trained model-based solution designed to integrate new knowledge while preserving past learning. Our contributions include pioneering RealCL as a generalization of traditional CL setups, proposing CLARE as an adaptable approach for RealCL tasks, and conducting extensive experiments demonstrating its effectiveness across various RealCL scenario

translated_title: 使用预训练模型的现实持续学习方法
translated_abstract: 持续学习（CL）评估学习解决方案在保留知识方面的适应性。我们的研究解决了灾难性遗忘的挑战，即模型在学习新任务时会丧失对先前学习任务的熟练度。虽然已提出众多解决方案，但现有实验设置往往依赖于理想化的类增量学习场景。我们引入了现实持续学习，这是一种新颖的持续学习范式，其中各任务的类别分布是随机的。我们还提出了CLARE（针对RealCL场景的基于预训练模型的持续学习方法），这是一种基于预训练模型的解决方案，旨在整合新知识的同时保留过去的学习成果。我们的贡献包括：开创性地将RealCL作为传统持续学习设置的泛化形式，提出CLARE作为RealCL任务的适应性方法，并通过大量实验证明了其在各种RealCL场景中的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出了类别分布随机的现实持续学习新范式RealCL，并设计了基于预训练模型的解决方案CLARE，能在整合新知识的同时保留旧知识，有效应对灾难性遗忘问题。
